payload.title: Write a short board-dispatch test report and post it as a comment
payload.description: Disposable real-board smoke-test task for the containerized Issue Router. Read the parent epic description, write a concise report of the safe multi-worker dispatch goals in 3 short paragraphs, and post those exact paragraphs as a comment on this issue using the router result issue_comments field. Do not modify source code, documentation, issue files, or any other board issue. Do not claim that integration tests passed; this task only verifies real issue dispatch and comment publication. A human will review the comment and close the task after the router run.
